description.value:
The Interlocutor works a hook of cold iron into the bearer and names it a sacrament — a rite of pain that makes the unkillable killable. The hook cannot simply be pried loose; only something profound can cut it out, and until then the sacrament is the bearer's to keep.

Against Lord Veyrin (the gift). While you bear the graft, your Strikes ignore Veyrin's physical resistances, and once you have drawn his blood his fast healing never switches back on — a regenerating vampire that stops regenerating. (Adjudicated against Veyrin's stat block; the graft simply makes him killable.)

The wound never closes (the cost). The hook cannot simply be pried loose, and it reopens the moment the fight begins: when you roll initiative, the wound tears and you begin to bleed. Apply @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-netherworld.effects.Item.nwWoundReopens01]{Effect: The Wound Reopens} (@Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage, flat DC 15 to end — it recovers as normal).

Impaling Chain 1

Frequency once per day

Cost wielding the cold iron tears you further — each time you make this Strike you take @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Effect You make a melee Impaling Chain Strike (added to your Strikes list): 2d8+7 piercing plus 1d6 persistent bleed, with the disarm, magical, reach, trip, and unholy traits (you add your Strength to its damage as with any melee weapon). On a critical hit the target is impaled and anchored in place — apply @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-netherworld.effects.Item.nwImpalingChain1]{Effect: Impaling Chain}: it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} by the chain and cannot recover from persistent bleed damage until it Escapes against your class DC or Athletics DC.
